item.text:
Refactored the repo by adding executable coverage around the DSU API. I added [UnionFindTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/008_disjoint_set_union_find/UnionFindTest.java), a small assertion-based test harness that checks empty-state behavior, unions/connectivity, component sizes/counts, and index validation. That gives the codebase a repeatable correctness check instead of relying only on the demo.

I also cleaned up [UnionFind.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/008_disjoint_set_union_find/UnionFind.java) a bit by centralizing the negative-size message and extracting the out-of-bounds message builder so validation logic is less ad hoc.

Verification passed with `javac DisjointSet.java UnionFind.java UnionFindDemo.java UnionFindTest.java`, `java UnionFindTest`, and `java UnionFindDemo`.
